snippet.title: Canadian Crossroads
snippet.description:
Welcome to Canadian Crossroads!

​I’m a creator based in Canada. This channel is a journey of exploration—starting from capturing the beauty of my surroundings through live streams of snowfalls and local parks, to my current mission: helping you navigate the "crossroads" of AI and productivity.

​Why the switch?

I realized the biggest way to empower our lives today is through technology. Now, I focus on:

​Practical AI Reviews: Deep-dives into Claude, ChatGPT, and the latest tech.

​Business Automation: Building smart "AI Stacks" for real-world growth.

​Human-Led Tech Guides: Every video is manually researched, scripted, and edited by me here in Canada.

​I started this journey sharing personal moments—from my son's dancing to live streams of the changing seasons. While the channel has grown into tech, that same commitment to authenticity remains. Join our 10,000+ community!

snippet.title: Dina Lu
snippet.description:
Sharing my honest business journey with you ❤️️  I started my first ever side business selling greeting cards in 2018. I then started to teach calligraphy workshops, and in 2019, I quit my 9-5 government office job to see if I could make it as a creative business owner. There were so many ups and downs, and it was a struggle in so many ways, but I kept going because I knew that if I wanted to inspire other people to pursue their dreams, I had to pursue my own dreams. During the pandemic, I started this YouTube channel. I've tried multiple businesses such as coaching, Etsy, affiliate marketing, user-generated content and the Amazon Influencer Program, but I didn't 100% passionate about any of them. As of this year (2025), I'm finding my soul business so I can feel truly aligned in life, work and my creative projects.

FAQ: 
Where are you from/where do you live? Vancouver, Canada
How old are you? Born in 1994 :)

Facebook: Dina Calligraphy
Instagram: dinadlu
